propositions: Duplicate tickets are filed for existing work and only discovered mid-implementation; same-title duplicates created within 171 seconds of their twin passed creation unflagged.
The overlap detector runs at plan-review time (ADR 0086), not at create time; create_core performs no similarity or duplicate check by design.

A 600-second rolling journal of recent creates, probed under fcntl.flock, detects same-normalized-title matches at creation and surfaces an advisory-only warning with the candidate ticket's id and status without blocking the create.
The advisory surface is implemented across CLI (stderr), library (return dict), and MCP (result field), and the warning never fails a completed write.
Two tickets (elfish-saltwater-pika, decagonal-indisposed-tamarin) require machine-readable duplicates links via the reopen-link-reclose pattern to record their duplicate relation.
